citations.M1: Expand, migrate and contract are collapsed into one Thursday window; `0143` belongs in a separate release days after the backfill reconciles.
citations.M2: from the moment step 2 deploys, new orders are written with `status` NULL, so `status IN ('paid','shipped')` silently omits them from the Finance Looker load — dual-write both columns instead.
citations.M3: `OrderState(row["state"])` raises `ValueError` on NULL, so every pre-existing order 500s for the hours between step 2 and step 4
citations.M4: `MAPPING` covers only the five lowercase spellings, so `PAID` (5210), `canceled` (1988), `complete` (417) and NULL (149) fall through to NULL
citations.M5: each updated batch leaves the result set, so the next `OFFSET` skips that many still-unmigrated rows — fix by keyset paging on `id > last_id`
citations.M6: `with conn.transaction():` wraps the whole loop, so this is one transaction over 61M rows, not a batched backfill — commit per batch so it is resumable
citations.M7: `jobs/nightly_finance_export.py` selects and filters on `o.status` and was missed because the grep was scoped to `app/`
citations.M8: Between the fixed backfill and `0143`: `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE state IS NULL` must return 0
citations.M9: Staging already failed this way and was read as green: `done: 1055000` is exactly 211 batches of 5000 ... 1,049,377 staging rows still have `state IS NULL` today
citations.M10: `0143`'s downgrade recreates `status` empty, so it restores the schema and not the data — rename to `status_deprecated` and drop it a release later instead.
citations.M11: prod's 61.4M rows are 29.2× staging, giving 5.4 hours at the linear floor
citations.M12: `op.alter_column(..., nullable=False)` takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and full-scans 61M rows — add a `NOT VALID` check, `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`, then `SET NOT NULL`
